text:
Nisha (People Ops): Quick checklist for Priya's first week — capturing things we discovered last hire. Pls chime in if I missed anything.
Sam (Hiring Manager): Appreciate it, Nisha. Can we include a 30/60/90 template and a mentor pairing schedule?
Nisha (People Ops): Yes — added below. Also adding a short calendar template for day 1 syncs.
onboarding-bot: New hire profile created for Priya K. Welcome email queued. :tada:
Alex (IT): Hardware request submitted. ETA for laptop + dongles: 2 business days. I put Priya on the provisioning list; asking for admin rights on dev VMs.
Sam (Hiring Manager): Thanks Alex. Also will need GitHub org invite and access to the dedicated Redwood Dedicated project.
Jordan (Eng): I'll add Priya to the infra repo and make a PR granting team read/write. Will set up dev credentials.
Taylor (Mentor): I'm happy to be mentor. Proposed 30-min daily sync for first week (Mon-Fri), then twice-weekly weeks 2-4. Thoughts?
Sam (Hiring Manager): That schedule sounds good. We should add a 1:1 cadence — weekly with me, weekly with mentor for first 90 days.
Nisha (People Ops): Putting everything into this minimal checklist that managers can copy. Copy/paste friendly.

```
First-week manager checklist (copy into calendar invite):
- Day 0: Confirm equipment + SSO + email access
- Day 1 AM: Welcome call (People Ops + Manager) 30m
- Day 1 PM: Team intro + product overview 45m
- Days 2-5: Role onboarding sessions (infra, APIs, codebase) 30-60m each
- End of Week 1: 30m check-in (Manager + Mentor) and 30m with People Ops
```

```
30/60/90 high-level goals (manager to customize):
- 30d: Environment setup, complete 3 small onboarding tickets, shadow team workflows
- 60d: Independent ownership of 1 feature/task, participate in oncall rotations
- 90d: Lead a small project, present a postmortem/learnings to team
```

Who to ask quick list:
- IT: @Alex for hardware/provisioning
- Eng infra: @Jordan for repo/env access
- Mentor: @Taylor for day-to-day questions
- Payroll/Benefits: People Ops (this channel)
- Security: eng-security on Slack for VPN/KMS requests

Nisha (People Ops): Also adding a tiny email template managers can use to introduce new hires to the team.

```
Subject: Welcome Priya K to Redwood Inference!
Hi team — please welcome Priya (Role). She starts tomorrow and will be paired with Taylor as mentor. Priya will be working on inference-serving features and infra optimizations. Please ping her for setup help and pair when possible.
```

Sam (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can we add a short rubric for the mentor to run first-week checkpoints?
Nisha (People Ops): Added — three quick prompts for mentor check-ins: 1) blockers 2) confidence on setup 3) one thing they learned. Keep it 15m max.
Taylor (Mentor): I can take the first two check-ins and then hand off to on-call lead after week 2.
Alex (IT): FYI if anyone needs to accelerate shipping hardware, DM me and I'll ship overnight.
Nisha (People Ops): Awesome — I'm going to paste this into the new hire thread and attach to Priya's profile. Thanks everyone :heart:
